description: Two new full-stack implementation assignments and two new full-stack maintenance assignments, frozen before stack scaffolds, reference implementations, or measured agent output.

common_contract.server: Expose the exact GET status route and typed POST JSON route declared by the task. Reject malformed JSON, missing fields, unknown fields, wrong field types, and non-JSON media types.
common_contract.browser: Expose the declared deterministic scalar browser function and return the exact frozen values in a real browser runtime.
common_contract.cross_target: The response field named by shared_result_field must equal the browser export for equivalent inputs.
common_contract.network: Bind only to 127.0.0.1 on the harness-selected port.

tasks.title: Build a shipping quote across HTTP and browser targets
tasks.statement: Implement the frozen Shipping Quote contract in the supplied stack. The quote subtotal is 500 + weight_units * 120 + zone * 80 cents. Fragile shipments add a 250-cent surcharge. The total is subtotal plus surcharge; service is economy below 1500 cents and tracked otherwise. The browser export returns the same total.
tasks.independence: New contract, vocabulary, formula, and fixtures; not derived from Release Radar or report 035.

tasks.title: Build a capacity planner across HTTP and browser targets
tasks.statement: Implement the frozen Capacity Planner contract in the supplied stack. Usable slots are max(slots - reserved, 0). Priority work adds two jobs to requested demand. Accepted jobs are min(usable, demand), overflow is max(demand - usable, 0), and state is clear when overflow is zero or overloaded otherwise. The browser export returns accepted jobs.
tasks.independence: New contract, vocabulary, formula, and fixtures; not derived from Release Radar or report 035.

tasks.title: Repair quota carryover agreement across surfaces
tasks.statement: Repair the supplied Quota Surface application. Effective capacity is limit + carryover. Remaining units are max(effective capacity - used, 0). Remaining percent is zero when effective capacity is zero; otherwise it is remaining * 100 divided by effective capacity using whole-number truncation. The HTTP response and browser export must use the same rule.
tasks.predeclared_defect: The application-logic module divides by the base limit instead of effective limit when carryover is present.
tasks.adaptation_boundary: Only the cross-surface quota-authority mechanism is adapted; no source, names, formula, fixture, or test is copied.

tasks.title: Repair tenant isolation in a browser-visible cache token
tasks.statement: Repair the supplied Tenant Cache application. The collision-free cache token is tenant_id * 1000000 + resource_id * 1000 + generation. The HTTP response and browser export must use that exact token. The state is isolated.
tasks.predeclared_defect: The application-logic module omits tenant_id, so equal resource/generation pairs alias across tenants.
tasks.adaptation_boundary: The mechanism and every fixture are new and were selected before any measured output.
